content: The status of Crimea is a complex and contentious international issue. Russia annexed Crimea from Ukraine in 2014, which most countries view as an illegal annexation. Ukraine and most of the international community consider Crimea to be Ukrainian territory, while Russia claims it as part of the Russian Federation. The United Nations and many countries do not recognize Russia's annexation.
